mapper.select: SELECT node_guid, tag FROM hydra_business_node_tags WHERE node_guid IN #{guid} ORDER BY node_guid, tag

SELECT DISTINCT ntag.tag FROM hydra_business_node_tags AS ntag INNER JOIN hydra_business_nodes AS node ON node.guid = ntag.node_guid WHERE ntag.tag LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY ntag.tag LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hydra_business_node_tags AS ntag INNER JOIN hydra_business_nodes AS node ON node.guid = ntag.node_guid WHERE ntag.tag = #{tag}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hydra_business_node_tags WHERE node_guid = #{nodeGuid} AND tag = #{tag}
